identityPolicy: Exact recorded CIM creation identity; descendants not older than verified snapshot parent. No PID-only/profile-only fallback.
workingSetSemantics: Sum of per-process working sets; shared pages can repeat, not unique physical footprint.
compilerThreadAttribution: Unavailable; process CPU/thread counts do not identify V8 compiler work.
error: Owned parent disappeared or was reused during child discovery; accounting is indeterminate, unverified child is not adopted.
